title: TC-TIB-023 — [Validation] Edit-save GO (any type) with invalid name/data/category now rejected via API
steps:
Preconditions: Staging portal; an existing Global Option (any type)

  1. On the Edit page (or artwork editor popup), make the Global Option invalid — e.g. clear its required name, or (for a category-based type) point it at a category of the wrong type
  2. Save
expectedResult: Save is blocked with a validation error from the API (previously this could save silently via direct DB write with no validation).
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com.

Observed (direct): On GO 969's Edit page (Single-line Text type), cleared the required "Global Option Name (internal)" field to empty and clicked Save. Save was blocked: a red error toast appeared reading "Error — Global Option Name is required". The field stayed empty and no success toast appeared (contrast with TC-021/022 where a successful save showed "Saved — Global option has been updated successfully."). Checked Network tab: a POST to https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/graphql fired at save time (200 response, GraphQL-style error-in-body pattern), i.e. the request round-tripped to the server rather than being silently rejected before any network call — consistent with API-layer validation per the dev's note, though the exact response payload wasn't inspected (no per-request body viewer available in this toolset).

Conclusion (direct observation): Invalid data (empty required name) on a Global Option edit-save is rejected with a clear validation error, matching expected result.
